==About==

A Honeylamp can be found in the wild or, with the [[Fungiculture]] skill learned, grown by planting another {{i|Honeylamp}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting a Honeylamp there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Honeylamp can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}.
